scientific_question: Does the large endpoint and row-Gram improvement from full-carry bilateral c_proj transport reduce complete-model CE when the replayed terminal weights replace the same five c_proj matrices in their dense trajectory endpoint checkpoint?

causal_scope.changed_variable: terminal c_proj weights for recorded layers 0,3,6,9,11: exact dense, replayed hidden88 right-only, hidden88+output32, or hidden88+output64
fixed_variables: same dense endpoint checkpoint for every non-c_proj parameter
same 238-step teacher-forced trajectory and learning-rate/weight-decay schedule
same fixed train and validation evaluation indices
same BF16 evaluation context and checkpoint model configuration

evaluation_protocol.terminal_state_persistence: save CPU float32 candidate c_proj states and their SHA-256 so task evaluation is auditable without a third replay

registered_decision_rule.candidate_pass: All values and logits/losses must be finite; candidate validation CE must be at least 0.002 below hidden88_full_carry; candidate train CE must be no worse than hidden88_full_carry; and candidate validation distance from dense endpoint must be smaller than the right-only distance.
registered_decision_rule.selection: Choose the first passing candidate to favor the smaller output coordinate budget.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_pass: A pass reopens only implementation of the selected no-learned-basis bilateral optimizer path, exact update/resume tests, and a separately preregistered directly polled >=20 percent MFU preflight. It does not authorize language-model training.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_failure: Do not implement bilateral output rotation. Treat its geometry gain as task-irrelevant in this dense-endpoint context and move to a preregistered bounded non-orthogonal residual diagnostic.

limitations: Only the five layers recorded by the source trajectory can be replaced, so this measures task relevance of representative-layer endpoint geometry rather than a complete twelve-layer production model.
Directions are teacher-forced from a dense run; a positive result establishes useful capacity and direction, not causal learnability without a teacher.
The dense endpoint checkpoint was itself trained for only 0.5 TPP.
